theory: Distinguish a closed walk from a cycle: starting and finishing at the same vertex does not by itself make a route a closed path, and a cycle has no other repeated vertices or edges. Make the path definition consistent with the booklet's explicit allowance for cycles by stating the start/end exception. Remove the unsupported equivalence between out-capacity and departures: outgoing weights represent capacity or departure counts only when the context defines them that way.
summary: Replaced seven off-booklet tasks with adapted flight totals, passenger departure totals or supplied-route comparisons, retaining their tiers and quiz id and providing source citations for every item. Clarified missing weight meanings and units, corrected the train-loop diagram and distractor, updated two structure slugs, and repaired theory definitions and power-loss wording without removing any whole items.
reviewSummary: All 19 requested items have correct answers and assess question types explicitly asked in the booklet; each reviewed quiz has exactly one correct option and accurate distractor explanations. The theory follows the booklet's methods and its convention that a cycle is a closed path, with no repairs or removals required.
